theme_and_archetype.reasoning: A dark, moody, cinematic visual style aligns perfectly with Archetype 5. It establishes an expensive, intimate, and romantic atmosphere for a premium Italian restaurant.

headings.weight_strategy: font-light or font-normal for high-end editorial feel
headings.tracking: tracking-tight or tracking-tighter for large text

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use p-8, p-12, p-24, p-32. Generous vertical breathing room between sections (py-24 or py-32).
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Asymmetrical text/image overlaps. Avoid center-everything disease. Left-align text blocks. Optical alignment for icons/buttons.
layout_and_spacing.bento_grid: For the photo gallery, use 'The Tetris Grid'. A mix of col-span-2, col-span-4, row-span-2. Wide gaps (gap-6 or gap-8). Never fill perfectly.
layout_and_spacing.section_structure: Hero (100vh), Story (Asymmetrical), Menu (List with generous spacing), Gallery (Bento), Footer (Massive py-32).

components.strategy: Strictly HTML + Tailwind. NO Shadcn needed for a visual-only marketing site. Do not use generic card components. Use pure HTML elements to maintain creative freedom.
components.buttons: Flat, sharp corners (rounded-none or max rounded-sm), 1px solid border (border-stone-700), hover:bg-stone-800 transition-colors. Primary CTA uses the ember accent.
components.navigation: Crystal glassmorphism sticky header (bg-stone-950/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/5). Links must be visible on desktop. No hamburger menu on desktop.
components.menu_items: Flex container with justify-between. Title and price on opposite ends. Dotted border-bottom (border-dotted border-stone-700) filling the gap. Description underneath.
components.hero_overlay: bg-black/50 maximum. Use gradient overlay (from-stone-950 via-stone-950/60 to-transparent) to ensure text readability without killing the image.

motion_and_interactions.scrolling: Smooth momentum scrolling via lenis is MANDATORY.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Images scale up slightly (scale-105) inside overflow-hidden containers. Text links use an animated underline.
motion_and_interactions.entrance: Staggered fade-up (translate-y-8, opacity-0 to opacity-100) using framer-motion when sections enter viewport.

hero_image.description: Dimly lit cinematic restaurant interior. Use as hero background.

gallery_images.description: Elegant plate of food with wine.
Single red rose on table. Good for romantic storytelling.

about_image.description: Black pendant light in dark room. Use for Chef's story or About section.

icons.usage: Use sparingly. Map pin for location, Chevron for reservation CTA.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements MUST use data-testid. Example: data-testid='reservation-cta', data-testid='nav-menu-link'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page React application using Vite/Next.
Do NOT use Shadcn UI. Rely on native HTML and Tailwind CSS classes to maintain the bespoke luxury aesthetic.
Apply 'Cormorant Garamond' for all headings and 'Manrope' for body text.
Ensure the hero image has a gradient overlay so text contrast is strictly maintained.
Implement Lenis for smooth scrolling and Framer Motion for subtle fade-in-up animations.
Build an asymmetrical, text-rich Chef's Story section.
Construct the Menu using a clean list format with dotted lines bridging the item name and price.
Build the Gallery using CSS Grid to create a bento/tetris asymmetrical pattern.
Ensure the reservation CTA is visually prominent but requires no backend.
